command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving (not copying) file1 into dir1. The evaluator checks that file1 no longer exists in the current directory but exists in dir1. Custom getter checks both source and destination locations to verify the move operation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the move operation semantics: file must not exist in source location and must exist in destination directory
Getter correctly checks both source and destination locations using bash file existence tests [ -f ]
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('in_source') and expected.get('in_dest')
Expected values are semantically correct: in_source=false, in_dest=true accurately represents a successful move operation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all requirements in the instruction (move file1 into dir1)
Data flow is correct: config provides source_file and dest_dir, getter extracts file existence state, metric compares against expected move semantics
Handles edge cases appropriately: distinguishes between move vs copy, handles missing files, uses reasonable timeout (10s)
No postconfig needed: file system state is persistent and doesn't depend on UI state
